title: Error.match cases must be static Error class names so nominal identity can be checked and lowered
notes: specification/failures.mdx, 'Error Prototype': 'Handler selection MUST use compiler-stable nominal identity, not a forgeable user _tag or minifier-sensitive constructor name in compiled artifacts.' A computed case key resolved from a runtime string is exactly the forgeable form the rule excludes; the cascade also reports the union member the computed key made unprovable.
